ex.zh: 当时，中央安全机构正积极参与通过核反应嬗变危险的化学物质。

ex.zh: 事实上，有些参与者被要求在冬季去密歇根州的植物园散步。

to think carefully and deeply about something

ex.en: The pattern of the Reindeer Industry in West Siberian of Russia is an important issue for ethnology.

words.remmethod: ethn(民族， 种族) + ology(…学) → 民族学

senses.zh: 卷笔刀；[机] 磨具；研磨者

Insouciance is lack of concern shown by someone about something that they are expected to take more seriously

a substance that shows that another substance in a  compound  exists, by causing a chemical  reaction

a recessive  gene  is passed to children from their parents only if both parents have the gene

fortuitous(偶然的) + ly(副词后缀) → 偶然地

to make a piece of machinery start to operate

ex.zh: 灵巧的针法

words.remmethod: dexter(右手) + ous(形容词后缀) → 惯用右手的

senses.zh: 易怒的，暴躁的；爱发牢骚的，抱怨的；爱挑剔的
senses.en: someone who is querulous complains about things in an annoying way

senses.zh: 爱发牢骚的； 易怒的； 爱挑剔的
senses.en: someone who is querulous complains about things in an annoying way

ex.en: ‘But why can’t I go?’ he said in a querulous voice.
ex.zh: “可是为什么我不能去呢？”他抱怨道。

words.remmethod: 发着发着牢骚 (querulous) 就变成吵架 (quarrel) 了

senses.zh: 洗礼；洗澡（常用复数）；斋戒沐浴
senses.en: the ritual washing of a priest's hands or of sacred vessels
the ritual washing of a priest's hands or of sacred vessels

ex.en: This is the hour of an ablution heart.
ex.zh: 这是一个洗礼心灵的时刻。

ex.en: As the herald of the new civilization, Desdemona allures the conceited hero to take off armour and attend the ablution of the new civilization.
ex.zh: 苔斯狄蒙娜装扮成新文明的使者，诱使自以为是的英雄卸下恺甲，参加了新文明的洗礼。

words.remmethod: ab + lut (冲， 洗) + ion (动作) → 清洗

senses.zh: 易怒的，暴躁的；带怒气的；撒娇的
senses.en: easily annoyed by small and unimportant things

ex.en: The kids were peevish after so long in the car.
ex.zh: 孩子们坐了这么长时间的汽车，随时会发脾气。

words.remmethod: 来自peeve(v. 使气恼， 使焦躁)

senses.en: not necessary or important and so easy to get rid of

ex.en: Part-time workers are considered dispensable.
ex.zh: 兼职工作人员被认为是可有可无的。

words.remmethod: dis(分离) + pens(重量) + able → 重量可被分割的 → 不必要的

senses.zh: 天真的；朴实的；无虚饰的
senses.en: natural, honest, and sincere
natural, honest, and sincere

ex.en: artless sincerity
ex.zh: 天真烂漫

words.remmethod: art(技巧；人工) + less(无) → 无雕饰的 → 朴实的
non(不) + con(共同) + form(形式) + ity(名词后缀) → 不墨守成规；不一致

senses.zh: 粗腔横调的；发音不和谐的

words.remmethod: caco(不好的) + phon(声音) + ous → 发音不和谐的

senses.en: someone who owns or works in a shop selling fruit and vegetables
someone who owns or works in a shop selling fruit and vegetables

ex.en: I bought these apples at the greengrocer's.
ex.zh: 我在蔬菜水果店里买了这些苹果。

ex.en: Elsa is telephoning the greengrocer. The plumber is putting a new seat on the toilet bowl.
ex.zh: 埃尔莎在给蔬菜水果商打电话，管子工在马桶上装了一个新座垫。

words.remmethod: green(绿色的)+grocer(零售商)→蔬菜水果商

senses.zh: 使变无效；使显得愚笨；使无价值
使显得愚笨； 使变无效， 使成为徒劳

words.remmethod: stult (看作stupid， 愚蠢的) + ify → 使显得愚蠢

senses.en: Herbivorous animals only eat plants
Herbivorous animals only eat plants

ex.en: " Cornett's attorney, Jack Johnston, said the tooth "looks like it would be from a herbivorous rodent of some type.
ex.zh: 科内特的律师杰克·约翰斯顿说，这颗牙“看起来像是某种食草的啮齿类动物的牙。”

ex.en: 'Chewing is a property which no large herbivorous terrestrial mammal has got rid of, ' said Professor Martin Sander, from Bonn University.
ex.zh: “现在，没有大型陆生食草哺乳动物是不需要咀嚼的，”波恩大学的马丁·桑德教授说。

words.remmethod: herb(草) + i + vor(吃) + ous → 食草的

senses.zh: 说模棱两可的话；支吾， 躲闪；推诿；含糊其词
senses.en: to avoid giving a clear or direct answer to a question

ex.en: He is equivocating a lot about what is going to happen if and when there are elections.
ex.zh: 他含含糊糊地说着很多如果进行选举会发生的状况。

words.remmethod: equivoc (看作equivocal， 模棱两可的) + ate (做…) → 说模棱两可的话

senses.zh: 游说， 拉选票； 细查
senses.en: to try to persuade people to support a political party, politician, plan etc by going to see them and talking to them, especially when you want them to vote for you in an election

ex.en: Candidates from all three parties were out canvassing in Darlington today.
ex.zh: 三个政党的候选人今天都在达灵顿拉选票。

ex.en: The US has been canvassing support from other Asian states.
ex.zh: 美国一直游说其他亚洲国家，寻求支持。

words.remmethod: 在帆布(canvas)上写上标语来拉选票(canvass)

senses.en: relating to or consisting of money
relating to or consisting of money

ex.en: He was trying to get a pecuniary advantage for himself.
ex.zh: 他拼命为自己敛财。

words.remmethod: pecuni(钱财) + ary → 金钱的

senses.en: to make iron or steel able to pull other pieces of metal towards itself

ex.en: His dark flashing eyes seemed to magnetize her.
ex.zh: 他那双炯炯有神的黑眼睛好像把她给迷住了。

words.remmethod: magnet(磁) + ize(使动后缀) → 使磁化

senses.zh: 不信奉英国国教的 n非国教徒

ex.en: Their views are nonconformist and their political opinions are extreme.
ex.zh: 他们的看法与众不同，政治观点也很极端。

words.remmethod: non(不) + conform(遵守) + ist → 不墨守成规的人

senses.en: a man who has a rank in the  aristocracy  , especially in Britain, or his title

senses.zh: 领主， 君主， 贵族
senses.en: a man who has a rank in the  aristocracy  , especially in Britain, or his title
a man in  medieval  Europe who was very powerful and owned a lot of land

ex.en: Lord Salisbury
ex.zh: 索尔兹伯里勋爵

ex.en: the feudal lords
ex.zh: 封建领主

words.remmethod: the Lord指“上帝”

senses.en: If something lacerates your skin, it cuts it badly and deeply
to cut skin deeply with something sharp

ex.en: Its claws lacerated his thighs.
ex.zh: 它的爪子挠伤了他的大腿。

ex.en: His fingers were badly lacerated by the broken glass.
ex.zh: 他的手指被碎玻璃严重割伤。

words.remmethod: lacer (撕) + ate → 撕开， 撕裂 → 割裂

senses.en: to live without doing much physical or mental activity and to feel bored as a result
to live without doing much physical or mental activity and to feel bored as a result

ex.en: I was determined when I retired that I wasn’t just going to vegetate.
ex.zh: 我退休时便下定决心绝不让生活过得单调无聊。

words.remmethod: veg(生活)+et+ate → 无所事事地生活

senses.en: letters and packages that are sent somewhere using a plane, or the system of doing this
letters and packages that are sent somewhere using a plane, or the system of doing this

ex.en: Send the letter by airmail.
ex.zh: 这封信用航空邮寄。

words.remmethod: air(天空)+mail(邮件)→航空邮件

senses.en: a printed piece of paper that you write an amount of money on, sign, and use instead of money to pay for things

ex.en: You could write her a cheque .
ex.zh: 你可以给她开张支票。

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 支票

senses.en: A suffragist is a person who is in favour of women having the right to vote, especially in societies where women are not allowed to vote

words.remmethod: suff + rag(破布) + ist → 主张让穿破布的人也参政 → 参政权扩大论者

senses.en: Something that is glutinous is very sticky
very sticky

ex.en: The sauce was glutinous and tasted artificial.
ex.zh: 这种粘酱尝起来感觉不自然。

ex.en: glutinous mud
ex.zh: 黏性泥

words.remmethod: 来自glue(n. 胶， 胶水)

senses.en: behaving in a sexually immoral or uncontrolled way
behaving in a sexually immoral or uncontrolled way

ex.en: She felt a little upset about her licentious behavior.
ex.zh: 她对他放肆的行为感到有点不舒服。

ex.en: She felt a bit comfortlessness to his licentious behavior.
ex.zh: 她对他放肆的行为感到有点不舒服。

words.remmethod: licent (允许； 放荡) + ious → 得到允许的 → 放肆的

senses.zh: 顽固的，执拗的；冷酷无情的
senses.en: very determined not to change your beliefs, actions, or feelings, in a way that seems unreasonable

senses.zh: 冷酷无情的； 顽固的， 执拗的
senses.en: very determined not to change your beliefs, actions, or feelings, in a way that seems unreasonable

ex.en: They argued, but he remained obdurate.
ex.zh: 他们发生了争论，但他还是固执己见。

words.remmethod: 持续的 (durable) 顽固 (obdurate)

senses.en: consisting of many cells

ex.en: a multicellular organism
ex.zh: 多细胞有机体

words.remmethod: multi(多的) + cellular(细胞的； 由细胞组成的) → 多细胞的

senses.en: A valedictory speech, letter, or performance is one that is intended as a way of saying goodbye when someone leaves another person, a place, or a job
a speech or statement in which you say goodbye when you are leaving a school, job etc, especially on a formal occasion
a speech or statement in which you say goodbye when you are leaving a school, job etc, especially on a formal occasion

ex.en: Mr. Walker made his valedictory address after two years as chairman.
ex.zh: 在担任主席职务两年后，沃克先生发表了告别演说。

words.remmethod: vale (告别) + dict (说) + ory → 告别的

senses.en: near the place where you are or the place you are talking about

ex.en: The fair attracted hundreds of people from the neighbouring towns and villages.
ex.zh: 集市吸引了邻近城镇及村庄的好几百人前来。

words.remmethod: neighbour(邻居) + ing(形容词后缀) → 邻近的；接壤的

senses.zh: 痉挛的，痉挛性的；间歇性的
senses.en: of or relating to a muscle spasm
happening for short irregular periods, not continuously

ex.en: a spasmodic cough
ex.zh: 痉挛性咳嗽

ex.en: spasmodic machine gun fire
ex.zh: 断断续续的机关枪射击

words.remmethod: 来自spasm (痉挛， 一阵发作) + odic → 痉挛的

senses.en: a newborn child, esp in the first week of life and up to four weeks old

ex.en: “Full, unabashed, total irradiation of a neonate,” Dr. Sclafani said, adding, “This poor, defenseless baby.
ex.zh: “对初生婴儿过量的毫不在乎的辐射，”Sclafani医生说，又接着说，“这些可怜的毫无防护能力的婴儿。”

ex.en: Central lines allow the easy administration of fluids and medication through the navel, and the neonate can receive necessary antibiotics through blood vessels in the arm.
ex.zh: 中间管线经肚脐向新生儿输送流质和药物，新生儿通过手臂上的血管接受必要的抗生素治疗。

words.remmethod: neo(新的) + nat(出生) + e → 新生儿

senses.en: a new word or expression, or a word used with a new meaning

senses.zh: 新语； 新词； 旧词新义
senses.en: a new word or expression, or a word used with a new meaning

ex.en: The newspaper used the neologism "dinks," Double Income No Kids.
ex.zh: 这份报纸使用了新词汇"dinks"—双收入无小孩的家庭。

words.remmethod: neo(新的) + log(说话) + ism → 新的话语 → 新字， 新词

senses.en: Provincialism is the holding of old-fashioned attitudes and opinions, which some people think is typical of people in areas away from the capital city or any large city of a country

ex.en: Wright grew frustrated with American provincialism.
ex.zh: 赖特对美国的地方偏狭观念愈发感到沮丧。

words.remmethod: province(省；地方) + ial(形容词后缀) + ism(特性；风尚) → 地方风尚

senses.en: Regimentation is very strict control over the way a group of people behave or the way something is done

ex.en: Democracy is incompatible with excessive, bureaucratic regimentation of social life.
ex.zh: 民主与受到过度的、官僚化的管制的社会生活是不相容的。

words.remmethod: regiment(团；编制) + ation(名词后缀) → 管辖

senses.zh: 努力， 尽力； 力图
senses.en: to try very hard

senses.zh: 努力， 尽力； 力图
senses.en: an attempt to do something new or difficult

ex.en: They are endeavouring to protect trade union rights.
ex.zh: 他们正在努力保护工会权利。

words.remmethod: end(尽头) + eav(看作eager， 热情) + our(我们的) → 用尽了我们的热情 → 努力， 尽力

senses.en: using an electrical current that is controlled by light

ex.en: Advanced imported photoelectric supervision system is used.
ex.zh: 采用先进的进口光电眼监控系统。

words.remmethod: photo(光) + electr(电) + ic(形容词后缀) → 光电的

senses.en: a long piece of music in which a large group of people sing

ex.en: Its peaks are the symphony and the oratorio.
ex.zh: 其顶峰为交响乐和清唱剧。

ex.en: Haydn wrote his oratorio The Creation and another equally splendid work for voices, The Seasons.
ex.zh: 海顿写了清唱剧《创世纪》和另一首也同样很出色的声乐作品《四季》。

words.remmethod: or(说) + at + orio(表音乐类) → 配以说话的音乐 → 清唱剧

senses.en: to make food or drink less pure by adding another substance of lower quality to it
to make food or drink less pure by adding another substance of lower quality to it

ex.en: The food had been adulterated to increase its weight.
ex.zh: 这种食物被掺了假以增加其重量。

words.remmethod: 奉承 (adulate) 话里都掺杂 (adulterate) 着谎话

senses.zh: 拖拉的；缓慢的，不慌不忙的
senses.en: slow in doing something
slow in doing something

ex.en: You might expect politicians to smooth things out when civil servants are being dilatory.
ex.zh: 当公务员办事拖拉时，你可能期望政治家们能够把事情顺利解决。

words.remmethod: di + lat(搬运) + ory → 分开搬运 → 慢吞吞的

senses.zh: 目空一切的，高傲的；傲慢的，自大的
senses.en: behaving as if you think that other people are less important than you – used to show disapproval

senses.zh: 自大的， 傲慢的， 目空一切的
senses.en: behaving as if you think that other people are less important than you – used to show disapproval

ex.en: supercilious wine waiters
ex.zh: 傲慢的侍酒师

words.remmethod: super(超过) + cili(眉毛) + ous → 超过眉毛 → 目中无人的

senses.zh: 纯正的；英币的；纯银制的

senses.en: the standard unit of money in the United Kingdom, based on the pound

ex.en: Ella has done some sterling work.
ex.zh: 埃拉做了一些出色的工作。

ex.en: Those are sterling qualities to be admired in anyone.
ex.zh: 那些优秀品质在任何人身上都值得称道。

words.remmethod: “斯大林”纯正的 (sterling) 思想让世人吃惊 (startling)

senses.en: the alleged power of perceiving things beyond the natural range of the senses

ex.en: The military initially focused on 'remote viewing', the scientific term for clairvoyance and extrasensory perception (or ESP).
ex.zh: 军方最初致力于开发“遥视”能力，这是千里眼和超感知觉的科学术语（或称ESP）。

words.remmethod: clair(看作clear， 清楚) + voy(看) + ance → 看得很清楚 → 超人的洞察力

senses.zh: 教师的, 教育学的, 教授法的

ex.en: The Educational category groups the educational and pedagogic characteristics of the learning object.
ex.zh: 教育（Educational）范畴包括学习对象的教育性和教育学特征。

words.remmethod: ped(= child 儿童) + agog(引导) + ic → 教育学的

senses.zh: 晒黑的；有晒斑的；日炙的
晒黑（sunburn的过去式和过去分词）

ex.en: Ground zero is The Thatch, the village pub joined, via its beer garden, to the even rowdier Billy Budds, rammed to the rafters with sunburnt revellers living the dream.
ex.zh: Thatch酒吧，这家乡村酒馆通过自己的啤酒花园，加入到了吵闹的比利巴德的行列，晒得黝黑、活在梦中的狂欢者的喧哗声充满着整个酒吧。

ex.en: She woke him anxiously shaking at his sunburnt shoulders.
ex.zh: 她焦急地摇着他被太阳晒黑的肩膀，唤醒了他。

words.remmethod: sun(太阳)+burnt(烧伤的)→被太阳灼伤的→晒黑的， 晒伤的

senses.en: an instrument that measures and records the movement of the earth during an  earthquake

ex.en: On the right waist have a seismograph, it tender prior to the earthquake forecast the earthquake.
ex.zh: 在右腰上有一个地震仪，它嫩在地震前预报地震。

ex.en: People always make some misunderstanding for the sampling rate and dynamic range of shallow seismograph.
ex.zh: 人们对浅层地震仪的采样率及动态范围这两个指标往往产生某些误解。

words.remmethod: seism(震动) + o + graph(写； 图) → 能描绘地震情况的(仪器) → 地震仪

senses.zh: 迟钝的，迟缓的；不活泼的；麻痹的；[生物] 蛰伏的
senses.en: not active because you are lazy or sleepy

senses.zh: 麻木的； 迟钝的；  冬眠的
senses.en: not active because you are lazy or sleepy

ex.en: a torpid mind
ex.zh: 迟钝的头脑

words.remmethod: torp(麻木；迟钝) + id(形容词后缀) → 麻痹的；迟缓的

senses.en: A storey of a building is one of its different levels, which is situated above or below other levels
a floor or level of a building

ex.en: A staircase leads to the upper storey .
ex.zh: 有一段楼梯通往上面一层。

words.remmethod: 可与store ( n. 商店)一起记

senses.en: the respect that you, your family, your country etc receive from other people, which makes you feel proud

senses.zh: 尊敬；[金融] 承兑；承兑远期票据
senses.en: to treat someone with special respect
to show publicly that someone is respected and admired, especially by praising them or giving them a special title

ex.en: He was showered with honours – among them an Oscar.
ex.zh: 他获得了很多荣誉–其中包括奥斯卡奖。

ex.en: In a marriage, you need to honour one another.
ex.zh: 婚姻中双方应该互相尊重。

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 荣誉；尊敬

senses.en: A rhythmic movement or sound is repeated at regular intervals, forming a regular pattern or beat

ex.en: Good breathing is slow, rhythmic and deep.
ex.zh: 良好的呼吸缓慢、有节奏并且深沉。

words.remmethod: rhythm(节奏) + ical(形容词后缀) → 节奏的

senses.en: a very young bird that cannot leave its nest because it is not yet able to fly

words.remmethod: nest(巢) + ling(小称) → 巢中小鸟 → 雏鸟

senses.en: If you say that someone has vivacity, you mean that they are lively, exciting, and attractive

ex.en: He was charmed by her vivacity and high spirits.
ex.zh: 她的活泼与兴高采烈的情绪把他迷住了。

ex.en: We were all affected by the vivacity of this lovely little boy.
ex.zh: 这个可爱的小男孩的快活使我们都受到感染。

words.remmethod: viv (生命) + acity → 活泼

senses.en: the tendency to use one hand more skilfully or in preference to the other

ex.en: An important factor that the researchers took note of was the participants' handedness.
ex.zh: 研究人员考察的一个重要因素是参与者的用手习惯。

words.remmethod: hand(手) + ed(有…的) + ness(名词后缀) → 用手习惯

senses.zh: 始终如一的， 不变的； 恒定的
senses.en: always happening in the same way, at the same time etc

ex.en: His invariable answer was ‘Wait and see.’
ex.zh: 他的回答总是那句话:“等着瞧吧。”

ex.en: Eluding is the invariable game.
ex.zh: 逃避是不变的游戏。

words.remmethod: in(无)+var(变化)+i+able→不变的

senses.zh: 奔放；兴高采烈；沸腾；冒泡
奔放的； 兴高采烈的

ex.en: She burst into the room with her usual ebullience.
ex.zh: 她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间。

ex.en: She burst into the room with her usual ebullience, and immediately started talking to everyone.
ex.zh: 她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间，立刻跟大家攀谈起来。

words.remmethod: e + bull(公牛) + ience → 像公牛一样出来 → 兴高采烈

senses.en: a musical instrument like a small  trumpet

words.remmethod: corn(角) + et(指小) → 小角 → 短号；圆锥形纸袋

senses.en: If you describe expressions of praise, apology, or gratitude as fulsome, you disapprove of them because they are exaggerated and elaborate, so that they sound insincere

ex.en: Newspapers have been fulsome in their praise of the former president.
ex.zh: 报界对前任总统的赞扬过于恭维了。

words.remmethod: ful(l)(满) + some(带有…的) → 充足的

senses.zh: 吵闹的，喧嚣的；难驾驭的
senses.en: If you say that someone is obstreperous, you think that they are noisy and difficult to control
noisy and refusing to do what someone asks

ex.en: You know I have no intention of being awkward and obstreperous.
ex.zh: 你知道我无意存心作对。

words.remmethod: ob + streper (喧闹) + ous → 喧嚣的

senses.zh: 合并， 接合； 联合

ex.zh: 在阿姆斯特丹附近，有一个人种学博物馆，里面介绍了木屐鞋的发展历史，还能了解这种独特木鞋的整个自动化制作过程。

senses.zh: 行为性的,  行为学的

ex.en: At Agile 2006, she examined the cooperative behavior of Bonobo apes from an ethological perspective and spoke about how “natural” the cooperative aspects of Agile are.
ex.zh: 在Agile2006上，她从动物行为学的角度分析了Bonobo大猩猩的合作行为，并说明了敏捷的合作性是多么“自然”。

ex.zh: 在2006年的敏捷开发大会上，她从行为学的角度详细分析了倭黑猩猩的合作行为，谈到敏捷开发在合作方面是多么的“自然”。

senses.en: any member of the Eukarya, a domain of organisms having cells each with a distinct nucleus within which the genetic material is contained

ex.en: Scientists now know that this common ancestor, 'the first eukaryote', was a lot more sophisticated than any known bacterium.
ex.zh: 科学家现在知道，这个共同的祖先，“第一真核生物”比任何已知的细菌都要复杂得多。

ex.en: Grypania may have been either a bacterial colony or a eukaryote — an organism with specialized cells, enclosed in a membrane.
ex.zh: 卷曲藻可能是一个菌落，或者一种真核生物——其包裹在细胞膜内的细胞功能已经出现分化的生物体。

words.remmethod: eu(真；良好) + karyo(核) + te → 真核细胞

ex.en: These genes are needed for cell respiration, and without them eukaryotic cells die.
ex.zh: 这些基因的细胞都需要呼吸，如果没有它们，真核细胞就会死亡。

ex.en: This overturns the traditional view that the jump to complex 'eukaryotic' cells simply required the right kinds of mutations.
ex.zh: 这颠覆了传统的观点，即实现复杂的'真核'细胞的跳跃发展仅仅要求正确种类的突变。

ex.en: That challenges Wilson's theory by suggesting that blood ties are indeed what get eusocial groups started, the team concludes in tomorrow's issue of Science.
ex.zh: 这就挑战了威尔森的理论，因为血缘关系确实是群居社会开始的原因。

ex.zh: 他在购物中心的花店里为她买了一些玫瑰。

words.remmethod: flor(花) + ist(表人) → 种花人

senses.en: a container filled with air or gas, fixed to something to make it float

ex.en: A rise in the value of old securities is an indispensable preliminary to the flotation of new issues.
ex.zh: 一只旧的有价证券的升值是浮现新问题的必不可少的第一步。

words.remmethod: flot(漂浮) + ation(名词后缀) → 浮选

senses.en: an area of ground, for example in a garden, in which flowers are grown

ex.en: Each flowerbed is populated with those classic English garden decorations: little statues of gnomes.
ex.zh: 他们各自的花圃开的花布满了那些传统英式花园，这些花就是地精的塑像。

ex.en: In one of our attacks the regiment ran into an almost insurmountable obstacle: enemy fire coming from an emplacement camouflaged as a flowerbed was mowing down the lines of our infantrymen.
ex.zh: 在一次进攻中我们团遇到了一个几乎无法逾越的障碍：敌人从伪装成花圃的掩体中向我军步兵射击打乱了其队形。

words.remmethod: flower(花) + bed(床；圃) → 花床；花圃

senses.en: a plastic or clay pot in which you grow plants

ex.en: Do you want me to eat dirt from a flowerpot?
ex.zh: 你想让我把花盆里的土都吃了还是咋地？

ex.en: He might as well plant an oak in a flowerpot, and expect it to thrive, as imagine he can restore her to vigour in the soil of his shallow cares!
ex.zh: 他与其想象他能在他那浮浅的照料中使她恢复精力，还不如说正像把一棵橡树种在一个花盆里！

words.remmethod: flower(花) + pot(盆) → 花盆

senses.en: a metal pipe or tube that lets smoke or heat from a fire out of a building

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 烟道；暖气管

ex.en: She can speak English fluently.
ex.zh: 她能流利地说英语。

ex.en: I can't speak English fluently as I am out of practice.
ex.zh: 我不能流利地说英语， 因为我已荒疏了。

words.remmethod: flu(流) + ent(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 流利地

ex.en: Because of the natural fluidity and immediacy of marketing, we are constantly building new areas of knowledge.
ex.zh: 由于市场固有的流动性和即时性，所以我们经常构建新知识领域。

ex.en: Sexual fluidity occurs in both men and women, but it has been suggested that women are potentially more open and malleable in this regard.
ex.zh: 除了女性，性别的流动性同样会出现在男性身上，但这有证据显示女性在这个方面更有可能和可塑性。

words.remmethod: fluid(流动) + ity(名词后缀) → 流动性；变移性

senses.en: a musical instrument like a thin pipe, that you play by holding it across your lips, blowing over a hole, and pressing down buttons with your fingers

ex.en: The boy trilled on a flute.
ex.zh: 男孩在长笛上吹颤音。

ex.en: He played a nice tune on the flute.
ex.zh: 他吹奏了一首优美的笛子曲。

words.remmethod: flut(吹) + e → 吹奏之物 → 长笛

ex.en: Or is it a flyspeck looking like a bird?
ex.zh: 或只是苍蝇留下的看起来像鸟的斑点？

words.remmethod: fly(蝇) + speck(斑点) → 蝇粪斑 → 污点；弄脏

ex.en: Yet the physical changes that go with affluence destroy the habitats of migratory shorebirds and seabirds, wreaking havoc on their numbers along the crucial East Asian-Australasian flyway.
ex.zh: 然而开发所带来的自然地理变化破坏了迁徙滨鸟和海鸟的栖息地，也就给重要的东亚-大洋洲候鸟迁徙路线沿途上的这些鸟类带来了灾难性的破坏，导致它们数量的剧减。

words.remmethod: fly(飞) + way(路) → 候鸟迁徙路径

senses.en: the focal thing is the one that people pay most attention to

ex.en: This issue has now become the focal centre of interest.
ex.zh: 这一问题现已成为关注的焦点。

words.remmethod: 来自focus(v. 聚焦)

senses.zh: 调节焦距； 使聚焦； 使集中

words.remmethod: foc(焦点) + al(…的) + ize(使…) → 调节焦距

senses.zh: 民间传说的, 民俗的

ex.en: T here are films as lovely, but none lovelier than "Cinema Paradiso, " a folkloric salute to the medium itself, flickering with yesterday's innocence and lingering on the mind like bubbles in wine.
ex.zh: 世 界上有如《天堂电影院》一般动人的影片，但绝无出其右，一部对媒体自身的民俗的礼赞，闪烁着往日的纯真无邪，如同葡萄酒中的泡泡那般萦绕心头挥之不去。

ex.en: The first was the so-called “hidden people”—or, to put it more plainly, elves—in whom some large number of Icelanders, steeped long and thoroughly in their rich folkloric culture, sincerely believe.
ex.zh: 第一个问题是所谓的“隐藏的人”——或者通俗地讲，小精灵——为数众多的冰岛人长久以来对他们丰富的民间传说深深相信并沉浸其中。

words.remmethod: folk(民众) + lor(e)(学问) + ic(形容词后缀) → 民间传说的

ex.en: The folkway and custom of Shijiazhuang Village, Anqiu City, are profound and famous.
ex.zh: 安丘市石家庄村的民俗风情是很浓厚且著名的。

ex.en: Abstr: The Liangshan is the bigest agglomeration, where the industrious and brave Yi people lived here who passed on the old tradional customs. The marriage customs still kept unique folkway.
ex.zh: 文章摘要： 凉山是彝族最大的聚居区，居住在这里的彝族同胞们勤劳勇敢，代代相传着古老的传统习俗，其中婚姻习俗仍然保留着独特民风民俗。

words.remmethod: folk(民间) + way(方式) → 民间的行事方式 → 社会习俗

senses.en: taking stupid and unnecessary risks

senses.zh: 鲁莽的， 有勇无谋的
senses.en: taking stupid and unnecessary risks

ex.en: a foolhardy attempt to capture more territory
ex.zh: 想占领更多地盘的鲁莽行为

words.remmethod: fool (傻子) + hardy (勇敢的) → 傻乎乎地勇敢 → 有勇无谋的

senses.zh: 山麓小丘, 丘陵地带
senses.en: one of the smaller hills below a group of high mountains

ex.en: the foothills of the Himalayas
ex.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉的山麓丘陵

words.remmethod: foot(脚；底部) + hill(山丘) → 山麓小丘

senses.en: a mark made by a foot or shoe

ex.en: We followed the footprints of a deer in the snow.
ex.zh: 我们追踪雪地里一头鹿的足迹。

words.remmethod: foot(脚) + print(印) → 足迹

ex.en: Looking like a puffy white star studded with little pearls, this is the shell of an amoeboid protist called a foraminifera, or foram.
ex.zh: 看看这个胀鼓鼓的白色星星，它上面满是珍珠。 这是一类变形虫（属于原生生物）的外壳，这类变形虫被称为有孔虫（ foraminifera or foram）。

ex.en: Globs of mud pulled from the trench have yielded an assortment of bacteria, fungi and primitive single-celled organisms called foraminifera.
ex.zh: 海沟中提取出的泥中生存着细菌、真菌和叫做有空虫类的原始单细胞有机体。

words.remmethod: foramin(小孔) + i + fera(携带者) → 带小孔的生物 → 有孔虫类

senses.zh: 福布斯（美国著名财经杂志）

words.remmethod: 本词(专有名词) → 福布斯

senses.en: a forceful person expresses their opinions very strongly and clearly and people are easily persuaded by them

ex.en: a forceful attack on government policy
ex.zh: 对政府政策的有力抨击

words.remmethod: force(力量) + ful(充满…的) → 有力的；强烈的

senses.en: a medical instrument used for picking up and holding things
a medical instrument used for picking up and holding things

ex.en: a pair of forceps
ex.zh: 一把镊子

words.remmethod: force(强) + ps(抓) → 用力抓取 → 镊子；钳子

senses.en: to warn of or indicate (an event, result, etc) in advance

senses.zh: 预示， 预言， 预兆
senses.en: to warn of or indicate (an event, result, etc) in advance

ex.en: can be, if I forebode aright, no power, short of the Divine mercy, to disclose, whether by uttered words, or by type or emblem, the secrets that may be buried with a human heart.
ex.zh: 如果我的预感不错的话，除去上天的仁慈，没有什么力量，无论是通过讲出来的语言或是任何形式的标志，能够揭示可能埋在一个人心里的秘密。

words.remmethod: fore(提前) + bode(兆头) → 预兆

senses.en: someone whose job is to say what is likely to happen in the future, especially what kind of weather is expected

ex.en: the weather forecaster
ex.zh: 气象预报员

ex.en: Economic forecasters think that the stock market is set to fall.
ex.zh: 经济预测专家认为股市很可能下跌。

words.remmethod: fore(预先) + cast(投掷；计算) + er(表人) → 预先推算的人 → 预报员

senses.zh: 前肢(指四肢或多肢动物的)前脚
senses.en: one of the two front legs of an animal with four legs

ex.en: In a proper depiction the hindleg would be forward too, having moved before the foreleg.
ex.zh: 正确的姿势应是，右后腿早应向前迈，并且应该在跨出前腿之前就迈出后腿。

ex.en: The researchers found, for example, that a skeleton of a dog at a Finnish museum depicts the right hindleg in a rearward position while the right foreleg is lifted and moving forward.
ex.zh: 例如，研究人员发现在一家芬兰博物馆中的一副狗的骨架，其右前腿已经离地向前而其右后腿仍在后方。

words.remmethod: fore(前) + leg(腿) → 前肢

senses.en: either of the front or anterior limbs of a four-limbed vertebrate: a foreleg, flipper, or wing

ex.en: The doctor said the problem lied in its forelimb and it would not die.
ex.zh: 医生说问题在于它的前肢上，不过它不会死的。

ex.en: And the rest of the forelimb-movement area is supposed to kick into gear and take over function.
ex.zh: 我们希望管控前肢的剩余区域能够迅速适应并接管机能。

words.remmethod: fore(前) + limb(肢) → 前肢

senses.en: to determine (events, results, etc) in the future
to determine (events, results, etc) in the future

ex.en: To foreordain or elect by divine will or decree.
ex.zh: 预定预先决定、判决或颁布；

ex.en: To appoint , decree , or ordain in advance foreordain .
ex.zh: 预定预先决定，判决或颁布；预先注定。

words.remmethod: fore(预先) + ordain(注定；命令) → 预先注定

senses.zh: 用透视法缩小； 缩短， 节略
senses.en: To foreshorten someone or something means to draw them, photograph them, or see them from an unusual angle so that the parts of them that are furthest away seem smaller than they really are

ex.en: She could see herself in the reflecting lenses, which had grotesquely foreshortened her.
ex.zh: 她可以在反射镜头中看到自己被怪异地缩短了。

words.remmethod: fore(在前面) + shorten(缩短) → 用透视法缩小
fore(预先) + sight(看见) + ed(形容词后缀) + ness(名词后缀) → 先见之明

senses.en: someone who works in a forest taking care of, planting, and cutting down the trees

words.remmethod: forest(森林) + er(表人) → 森林人；林务官

senses.en: when someone forgives another person

words.remmethod: forgive(原谅) + ness(名词后缀) → 宽恕

senses.en: to make a plan, decision, or idea official, especially by deciding and clearly describing all the details

ex.en: Final arrangements for the takeover have yet to be formalized.
ex.zh: 这次收购的最后协议还没有正式确定。

words.remmethod: form(形式) + al(形容词后缀) + ize(动词后缀，使…) → 使正式；形式化

senses.en: officially

ex.en: We announced a decision formally recognizing the new government.
ex.zh: 我们宣布了一个决定，正式承认新政府。

words.remmethod: form(形式) + al(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 正式地，形式上

senses.en: towers, walls etc built around a place in order to protect it or defend it

ex.en: a site of ancient fortifications dating from about 500 B.C.
ex.zh: 公元前500年左右的一个古代防御工事遗址

words.remmethod: fort(强；坚固) + ific(使成为) + ation(名词后缀) → 使坚固之物 → 防御工事
fossil(化石) + ization(…化) → 化石作用

senses.en: a place where metals are melted and poured into  mould s (= hollow shapes )  to make parts for machines, tools etc

ex.en: an iron foundry
ex.zh: 铸铁厂

words.remmethod: found(铸造) + ry(场所) → 铸造；铸造场

senses.en: by or up to four times as many or as much
four times as much or as many

ex.en: Further down the supply chain, garlic prices have jumped tenfold on wholesale markets in big cities and fourfold nationwide.
ex.zh: 沿供应链向下，其大城市批发价格跳升十倍，而全国售价则上升四倍。

ex.en: The "other" division, in which they are lumped with cloud services, grew nearly fourfold, but is still less than one-tenth of the top line.
ex.zh: 与云服务一同被归类到“其他”业务的部门增长近四倍，但营收仍不到总营收的十分之一。

words.remmethod: four(四) + fold(倍) → 四倍的

ex.en: Actually, it only takes one drink to get me loaded. Trouble is, I can't remember if it's the thirteenth or fourteenth.
ex.zh: 事实上，只有一杯酒就让我醉倒了，糟糕的是，我不能想起来它是第十三杯还是第十四杯。

words.remmethod: fourteen(十四) + th(第…；…分之一) → 第十四；十四分之一
frank(自由) + lin(表人) → 小地主；乡绅

senses.en: used to show that you are saying what you really think about something

ex.en: Frankly, I think the Internet is overrated.
ex.zh: 坦率地说，我认为因特网被高估了。

ex.en: His behaviour was frankly disgraceful.
ex.zh: 他的行为老实说是可耻的。

words.remmethod: frank(坦率) + ly(副词后缀) → 坦率地

senses.en: working independently for different companies rather than being employed by one particular company

ex.en: She works freelance from home.
ex.zh: 她在家做自由职业者。

words.remmethod: free(自由) + lance(看作lines， 几行字) → 自由地写东西做事 → 当自由职业者

senses.en: frenzied activity is fast and uncontrolled, usually because it is done by someone feeling very anxious or excited

senses.zh: 狂乱的， 激怒的， 疯狂似的
senses.en: frenzied activity is fast and uncontrolled, usually because it is done by someone feeling very anxious or excited

ex.en: A woman was stabbed to death in a frenzied attack on her home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚一名女子在家中遭遇疯狂袭击，被刺身亡。

ex.en: frenzied efforts to find a solution
ex.zh: 寻求解决办法的疯狂努力

words.remmethod: frenzi(疯狂) + ed(形容词后缀) → 疯狂的；狂乱的；激怒的

senses.en: a student who has just started at a college or university

words.remmethod: fresh(新) + er(表人) → 大学一年级新生；新鲜人

senses.zh: 焦躁的；烦燥的；起波纹的
senses.en: If someone is fretful, they behave in a way that shows that they are worried or unhappy about something
anxious and complaining, and unable to relax

ex.en: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
ex.zh: 不要你的婴儿一焦躁就假定她必然需要喂食。

ex.en: The child was tired and fretful.
ex.zh: 这孩子累了，很烦躁。

words.remmethod: 来自fret (v. 烦恼， 焦急)
freud(佛洛伊德) + ian(形容词/名词) → 佛洛伊德学说的

senses.en: Friday is the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: Mr. Cook is intending to go to the Middle East on Friday.
ex.zh: 库克先生正打算星期五去中东。

words.remmethod: fri(弗里格；爱神) + day(日) → 星期五

ex.en: His kind smile soon generated friendliness.
ex.zh: 他友善的微笑很快造成了友好的气氛。

ex.en: But American friendliness is not always an offer of true friendship.
ex.zh: 然而美国人的友好并不总是真正友情的表示。

words.remmethod: friend(朋友) + li(表性质) + ness(表状态) → 友善

senses.en: a decoration that consists of narrow piece of cloth that has many small folds in it

ex.en: She was wearing a white blouse with frills at the cuffs.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件袖口有褶边的白衬衫。

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 褶边；装饰

ex.en: By monitoring their brain waves, he saw a pattern of high frequency neural activity in the right frontal cortex that identified in advance who would solve a puzzle through insight and who would not.
ex.zh: 通过脑电波监测，他发现这些人在解开谜语之前，其右额叶皮质会出现一种高频率的神经活动，通常在得出答案的八秒钟甚至更短的时间内发生。

senses.en: a frontal view, as in a painting or other work of art

words.remmethod: front(前面；正面) + al(…的) + ity(名词后缀) → 正面描绘

senses.zh: 不整洁的（等于frowsy）；有臭味的；霉臭的

ex.en: There were frowzy fields, and cow-houses, and dunghills, and dustheaps, and ditches, and gardens, and summer-houses, and carpet-beating grounds, at the very door of the Railway.
ex.zh: 在铁路线开始的地方有霉臭难闻的田野、牛棚、粪堆、垃圾堆、水沟、菜园、凉亭和敲打地毯的场地。

ex.en: Filled the door with her frowzy bulk; frowzy white hair; slovenly appearance.
ex.zh: 懒散的她堵在门口；凌乱的白发；不修边幅的外表。

senses.zh: 无常的；短暂的；易逃逸的

passing quickly away; transitory; fleeting

ex.en: We apperceive joy and cheers, apperceive variance of fugacious years during the life long journey.
ex.zh: 生生不息中，我们悟到的是生命绽放的喜悦，岁月无常的变迁；

senses.en: a person who fulls cloth for his living

senses.en: the quality of being large and round in an attractive way

ex.zh: 下唇使用红色唇彩让它显得丰盈饱满。

senses.en: completely

ex.en: The restaurant is fully booked this evening.
ex.zh: 今晚这家餐厅订满了。

ex.en: Elisa has not fully recovered from the incident.
ex.zh: 埃莉莎还没有完全从这个事件中恢复过来。

senses.en: the idea that the most important thing about a building, piece of furniture etc is that it is useful

ex.zh: 晚近针对「新现实主义」与「新功能主义」之批判所发展出的「知识社群」研究取向，强调原创理念在政策塑过程中所扮演之重要角色。

senses.en: in every way that is important or basic
in every way that is important or basic

ex.en: The conclusions of the report are fundamentally wrong .
ex.zh: 这份报告的结论从根本上来说就是错误的。

ex.en: The political culture of the US is fundamentally different .
ex.zh: 美国的政治文化迥然不同。

words.remmethod: fundament(基础) + al(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 根本上

senses.en: connected with or caused by a  fungus

ex.en: a fungal infection
ex.zh: 真菌感染

ex.en: Without the fungi, this would be just another sandbar.
ex.zh: 如果没有真菌，这里将成为另一个沙洲。

ex.zh: 但是，如果没有真菌，我们就不会有花园、住宅，甚至脚。

ex.en: Despite these new relationships, the fungible nature of oil will limit the extent to which this economic shift eastward translates into a geopolitical one.

ex.zh: 这种孤注一掷的作法，使我感到这些代价重大的战役，也许正是陆上即将发生。

ex.en: Crucial events impend in Europe.
ex.zh: 欧洲即将发生具有决定意义的事变。

words.remmethod: im ＋ pend(悬挂) → 事情挂在眼前 → 即将发生

senses.zh: 顽固的人；不知悔改的人

senses.en: not sorry or penitent; unrepentant
not sorry or penitent; unrepentant

ex.en: Endless, of the impenitent and unbelieving.
ex.zh: 无止境的，对不知悔改的和不信。

ex.en: We need to remember that God's wrath does burn against impenitent sinners (Psalm 38:1-3).
ex.zh: 我们必须铭记上帝的愤怒曾烧死了不知悔改的恶人（圣歌38：1-3）。

words.remmethod: im(不) + penitent(悔过的) → 死不悔改的 → 不知悔悟的

senses.en: not completely correct or perfect
the form of a verb which is used when talking about an action in the past that is not complete. For example, ‘I was eating’.

ex.en: the imperfect world we live in
ex.zh: 我们生活于其中的不完美的世界

words.remmethod: im(不) + per(完全) + fect(做) → 未做完全 → 有缺点的

ex.en: So why then do we reject the impermanence of the ever-changing universe when it comes to our own lives?
ex.zh: 所以，为什么我们要拒绝这千变万化的宇宙中的无常，当它来到我们身边时？

ex.en: During difficult times, be committed to resolving problems, but also lighten up and ride the waves of impermanence.
ex.zh: 身处困境时，既要全神贯注地解决问题，也要身心放松，驾驭无常的世事。

words.remmethod: im(不) + perman(持久) + ence(名词后缀) → 不持久 → 暂时；无常
im(不) + per(贯穿) + man(停留) + ency(名词后缀) → 不停留 → 非永久性

ex.en: They do, however, greatly affect the implementation of those patterns.
ex.zh: 然而，它们的确对那些模式的 实现影响很大。

ex.en: If I now scroll down to the actual implementation, now does this work or not work?
ex.zh: 如果现在我向下滚动到实际的执行中，这个是可用的还是不可用的呢？

words.remmethod: 来自implement(v. 实施； 实现)
im(在内) + plic(折叠) + it + ly(副词后缀) → 折叠在内地 → 暗示地；含蓄地

senses.en: the act of bringing something new or different to a place where it did not previously exist, or something that arrives in this way

ex.en: We should stop the importation of these birds which are sold as commodities and endure lives of boredom in cages.
ex.zh: 这种作为商品出售的鸟被关在笼子里忍耐着无聊的生活，我们应当停止它的进口。

ex.en: While not legally binding the new levels allow countries to refuse to allow the importation of products with excessive levels of melamine.
ex.zh: 这一最新含量虽然不具法律约束力，但可使各国政府拒绝进口三聚氰胺含量过高的产品。

words.remmethod: im(入) + port(运) + ation(名词后缀) → 运入 → 进口

senses.en: a person, company, or country that buys goods from other countries so they can be sold in their own country

ex.en: Japan is the biggest importer of U.S. beef.
ex.zh: 日本是美国牛肉的最大进口国。

words.remmethod: im(入) + port(运；载) + er(表人) → 输入者；进口商

senses.en: continuously asking for things in an annoying or unreasonable way

senses.zh: 不断要求的， 急切的

ex.en: importunate demands
ex.zh: 无理的要求

words.remmethod: important → 因为十分重要， 所以一再要求 → 不断要求的
im(使…) ＋ pos(放置) ＋ ition → 强行放置 → 强加

senses.zh: 无力的；无效的；虚弱的；阳萎的
senses.en: unable to take effective action because you do not have enough power, strength, or control

senses.zh: 无力的， 虚弱的； 无效的
senses.en: unable to take effective action because you do not have enough power, strength, or control

ex.en: Emergency services seem impotent in the face of such a disaster.
ex.zh: 面对这种灾难，应急服务机构似乎无能为力。

ex.en: impotent rage
ex.zh: 于事无补的狂怒

words.remmethod: im (不) + potent (有力的) → 无力的

senses.en: not sensible or possible for practical reasons

ex.en: The road toll scheme was dismissed as impractical.
ex.zh: 公路收费计划由于不切实际而遭到否定。

ex.en: James was a foolish man, full of impractical plans.
ex.zh: 詹姆斯是个愚蠢的人，满脑子都是不切实际的计划。

words.remmethod: im(不) + practic(实践) + al(形容词后缀) → 不切实际的

senses.zh: 使怀孕, 使受精 a怀孕的, 充满的
senses.en: to make a woman or female animal pregnant

ex.en: Undercover officers found drug-making equipment used to impregnate paper with LSD.
ex.zh: 卧底警官发现了用于使迷幻药渗入纸张的毒品制造设备。

words.remmethod: im(入；使) + pregn(怀孕) + ate(使动) → 使怀孕；使充满

ex.en: impressionist painters
ex.zh: 印象派画家

words.remmethod: impress(印；留下印象) + ion(名词后缀) + ist(表人) → 印象主义者

senses.zh: 印象派的,给人深刻印象的
senses.en: An impressionistic work of art or piece of writing shows the artist's or writer's impressions of something rather than giving clear details

ex.en: His paintings had become more impressionistic as his eyesight dimmed.
ex.zh: 随着他的视力减弱，他的画变得越来越富有印象派风格。

words.remmethod: impression(印象) + ist(表人/流派) + ic(形容词后缀) → 印象派的

senses.zh: 令人难忘地,  令人印象深刻地

words.remmethod: im(入) + press(压) + ive(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 压入印象 → 令人印象深刻地

ex.en: It was the improvisation of the ebullition.
ex.zh: 它是激情迸发的即兴创作。 哟！

words.remmethod: im(不) + pro(前) + vis(看) + ation(名词) → 不预先看 → 即席创作

senses.en: If you refer to someone's inaction, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing

ex.en: He is bitter about the inaction of the other political parties.
ex.zh: 他为其他政党的不作为感到愤愤不平。

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 不作为

senses.en: not doing anything, not working, or not moving

ex.en: The brain cells are inactive during sleep.
ex.zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。

ex.en: Young people are becoming politically inactive.
ex.zh: 年轻人变得不热衷政治了。

words.remmethod: in(不) + act(行动) + ive(表形容词) → 不行动的 → 不活跃的，停滞的

senses.en: the state of not doing anything, not moving, or not working

ex.en: Don’t suddenly take up violent exercise after years of inactivity.
ex.zh: 多年没锻炼不要突然进行剧烈运动。

ex.en: The time spent between jobs should not be a period of inactivity.
ex.zh: 工作之余不应无所事事。

words.remmethod: in(不) + act(行动) + ivity(名词后缀) → 不活动；迟钝

senses.en: a feeling that you are not as good, clever, skilled etc as other people

ex.en: Unemployment can cause feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem.
ex.zh: 失业会使人缺乏自信，产生自卑感。

words.remmethod: in(不) + ad(向) + equ(相等) + acy(名词后缀) → 不足
in(不) + ad(向) + equ(相等) + ate(动/形) + ly(副) → 不相等地 → 不够地；不够好

senses.zh: 疏忽的；不注意的（副词inadvertently）；无意中做的
senses.en: An inadvertent action is one that you do without realizing what you are doing
An inadvertent action is one that you do without realizing what you are doing

ex.en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.
ex.zh: 政府声称那是无意的过失。

words.remmethod: 与inattentive (不注意的) 形近， 一起记

senses.zh: 空虚， 空洞； 无意义的事物

ex.en: Attempting to drown herself in inanity, she marries Peter Keating, only to leave him for newspaper tycoon Gail Wynand, publisher of the Banner, where Toohey's column appears.
ex.zh: 为了把自己淹没在空虚之中，她先嫁给了彼特·基廷，然后仅仅是为了离开他而选择了报业大亨盖尔·威纳德。 威纳德是巴纳出版社的老板，也就是图希的专栏出现的地方。

words.remmethod: in(无) + an(气息) + ity(名词) → 无气息 → 空虚；愚蠢

senses.zh: 不可估量的，无法计算的
senses.en: too great to be calculated

ex.en: Her contribution to our work is incalculable.
ex.zh: 她对我们工作的贡献极大。

words.remmethod: in(不) + calcul(计算) + able(可…的) → 不可估量的，无法计算的

senses.en: If something incapacitates you, it weakens you in some way, so that you cannot do certain things

ex.en: A serious fall incapacitated the 68-year-old congressman.
ex.zh: 一次严重跌伤使这位68岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。

words.remmethod: in(无) + capac(=cap握住) + it + ate(使…) → 使无力握住 → 使无资格； 使失去能力

ex.en: And it can be frustrating to watch a beloved pet scratch incessantly—especially after you’ve tried everything to get rid of the pests.
ex.zh: 看着自己心爱的宠物不停地挠啊挠相当令人烦躁——尤其是在你费尽心思除去那些害虫的时候。

ex.en: The detective rarely spoke during the session but smoked his pipe incessantly.
ex.zh: 开会的时候，侦探很少开口，只是不停地抽烟斗。

words.remmethod: in(不) + cess(停止) + ant(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 不间断地

ex.en: The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
ex.zh: 可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。

ex.en: If you have ever experienced the childlike delight of discovering an inchworm, you know how fun they are to watch.
ex.zh: 如果你有过看到尺蠖露出孩子般灿烂笑脸的经历，你就知道观察尺蠖是多么有趣。

words.remmethod: inch(英寸) + worm(虫) → 尺蠖

senses.en: happening or existing in connection with something else that is more important

senses.zh: 偶然的； 附带发生的， 伴随而来的
senses.en: happening or existing in connection with something else that is more important

ex.en: Increased motivation is more than an incidental benefit of reward schemes.
ex.zh: 积极性提高不仅仅是奖励计划附带的益处。

words.remmethod: incident(事件；附带) + al(形容词后缀) → 附带的

senses.zh: 险恶的；气候严酷的；狂风暴雨的
senses.en: inclement weather is unpleasantly cold, wet etc
inclement weather is unpleasantly cold, wet etc

ex.en: Confrontation between the two sides ensued for 3 hours as a result, eventually with the Vietnamese Navy retreating due to inclement weather.
ex.zh: 双方的对抗持续了3小时，最终越南海军由于险恶的天气而撤退。

ex.en: This space wraps around the southern side of the house, and is covered by an overhanging roof. A fireplace allows residents to enjoy the outdoors, even in inclement weather.
ex.zh: 这部分空间包裹着建筑的南面，被悬挑屋顶覆盖。即使在恶劣的天气情况下，壁炉的存在使居民可以更享受户外空间。

words.remmethod: in(不) + clement(仁慈的) → 不仁慈的 → 严酷的； 严厉的

senses.zh: 改名的；微行的；隐姓埋名的
senses.en: Someone who is incognito is using a false name or wearing a disguise, in order not to be recognized or identified

ex.en: Hotel inspectors have to travel incognito.
ex.zh: 酒店检查员巡查时必须隐瞒真实身份。

words.remmethod: in(不) + cognit(知道) + o → 不让人知道身份地 → 隐名埋姓地；化名地

senses.en: insufficiently spacious; cramped

senses.zh: 不便的， 偏促的， 狭窄的
senses.en: insufficiently spacious; cramped

ex.en: I awoke with stiff and cramped muscles from having slept long on the incommodious seat of a day coach.
ex.zh: 由于在座席客车不舒服的座位上睡了太久，我肌肉僵硬麻痹的醒来。

ex.en: Indeed, while the internal structure of the code that comprises the application is incommodious to change and difficult to trace, externally the system may fulfill its functional requirements well.
ex.zh: 必须承认，当组成程序的代码的内部结构不适应更改，或者很难追踪时，在外部系统可能还会很好的履行它的职责。

words.remmethod: in(不) + commod(方便；宽敞) + ious(形容词后缀) → 不方便的 → 狭窄的

senses.en: extremely good, beautiful etc, and much better than others

ex.en: an incomparable view of San Marco
ex.zh: 圣马科美妙绝伦的景色

ex.en: a wine of incomparable flavour
ex.zh: 香醇无比的葡萄酒

words.remmethod: in(不) + com(共同) + par(相等) + able(可…的) → 不可比的 → 无比的，无可匹敌的

ex.en: A standardized programming model should be introduced to avoid technology incompatibility problems.
ex.zh: 应该引入标准化编程模型来避免技术不兼容性问题。

ex.en: In a time when there is so much dispute about the compatibility or incompatibility of science with religion, it may be a good idea to revisit what Newton and Einstein had to say about God.
ex.zh: 在这个科学与宗教到底相容还是不相容众说纷纭的时候 还是让我们重新审视一下牛顿和爱因斯坦怎么说主吧。

words.remmethod: in(不) + compat(相容) + ibility(名词后缀) → 不兼容

senses.en: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly

ex.en: The incompetence of government officials is appalling.
ex.zh: 政府官员的无能令人吃惊。

words.remmethod: in(不) + com(共同) + pet(追求；能力) + ence(名词后缀) → 没有能力 → 无能

ex.en: Carbon monoxide is released when carbon in fuel—both plants and fossil fuels like gasoline—burns incompletely.
ex.zh: 当作为燃料的碳——包括植物和化石燃料比如汽油——不完全燃烧时，就会产生一氧化碳。

ex.en: The researchers found that the effect of soot, which is incompletely burned fuel, would dwarf that of the carbon dioxide emissions from the launches.
ex.zh: 研究者发现，燃料不完全燃烧产生的烟尘，会使发射过程中产生的二氧化碳的排放量减少。

words.remmethod: in(不) + com(完全) + plet(填满) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 不完全地

senses.en: a situation in which two statements are different and cannot both be true

ex.en: There were several glaring inconsistencies (= very noticeable differences ) in his report.
ex.zh: 他的报告中有几个明显的前后矛盾之处。

words.remmethod: in(不) + con(共同) + sist(站立) + ency(名词后缀) → 不能站在一起 → 矛盾；不一致

senses.zh: 不显眼的,不引人注意的
senses.en: not easily seen or noticed

senses.zh: 不引人瞩目的， 不显眼的
senses.en: not easily seen or noticed

ex.en: an inconspicuous little restaurant
ex.zh: 一家不起眼的小饭店

ex.en: She stood by the wall, trying to look inconspicuous.
ex.zh: 她贴墙站着，尽量不引人注目。

words.remmethod: in(不) + con(共同) + spic(看) + uous(表性质) → 不显眼的

senses.zh: 难以觉察地, 不显著地

words.remmethod: in(不) + con(共同) + spic(看) + uous(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 难以觉察地
in(不) + cor(共同) + rect(正) + ly(副词后缀) → 不正确 → 错误地

senses.en: unable or unwilling to believe something

ex.en: ‘You sold the car?’ she asked, incredulous.
ex.zh: “你把车卖了？”她难以置信地问道。

words.remmethod: in(不) + cred(相信) + ul + ous(形容词后缀) → 怀疑的

senses.en: a sudden attack into an area that belongs to other people

senses.zh: 袭击， 突然入侵； 介入
senses.en: a sudden attack into an area that belongs to other people

words.remmethod: in(入) + curs(跑) + ion(名词后缀) → 跑入 → 入侵

ex.en: In each of these cases, one of the models evolved independently of the other.
ex.zh: 在这里的每种情况下，其中一个模型独立于另一个模型而发展。

ex.en: Service each copy independently: You can update one copy without affecting any of the other ones.
ex.zh: 独立维护每个副本： 可以独立更新某一个副本，而不影响其他的副本。

words.remmethod: in(不) + de(下) + pend(悬挂) + ent(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 不挂在别人下面 → 独立地

senses.en: food that is indigestible cannot easily be broken down in the stomach into substances that the body can use

ex.en: indigestible statistics
ex.zh: 看不懂的统计数字

words.remmethod: in(不) + digest(消化) + ible(可…的) → 不吸收的；难理解的

senses.en: a dark purple-blue colour

words.remmethod: indigo(自身词根) → 靛；靛青

ex.en: I heard the news indirectly.
ex.zh: 这消息我是间接听来的。

ex.en: So it tries to control them indirectly.
ex.zh: 因此它试图间接地控制它们。

words.remmethod: in(不) + direct(直接) + ly(副词后缀) → 间接地

senses.en: very difficult to see, hear, or notice
very difficult to see, hear, or notice

ex.en: The path was almost indiscernible in the mist.
ex.zh: 迷雾中小路依稀难辨。

words.remmethod: in(不) + discern(辨别) + ible(可…的) → 难识别的

senses.en: careless about what you say or do, especially by talking about things which should be kept secret
careless about what you say or do, especially by talking about things which should be kept secret

ex.en: It was very indiscreet of Colin to tell them about our plan.
ex.zh: 科林把我们的计划告诉了他们，太不谨慎了。

words.remmethod: in(不) + dis(分开) + creet(辨别；判断) → 不辨别的 → 不慎重的

senses.zh: 任意的；无差别的；不分皂白的
senses.en: an indiscriminate action is done without thinking about what harm it might cause

senses.zh: 不加分析的， 不加选择的
senses.en: an indiscriminate action is done without thinking about what harm it might cause

ex.en: the indiscriminate use of chemical fertilizers
ex.zh: 化肥的滥用

words.remmethod: in(不) + discriminate(区别) → 不加区别的

senses.zh: 明白的；无争论之余地的

senses.zh: 无争论之余地的， 明白的
senses.en: If you say that something is indisputable, you are emphasizing that it is true and cannot be shown to be untrue

ex.en: It is indisputable that birds are harbouring this illness.
ex.zh: 无可争辩的是，鸟类携带着这种疾病。

words.remmethod: in (不， 无) + disputable (有争议的) → 毫无争议的， 不可争辩的

senses.en: a rare soft silvery metallic element associated with zinc ores: used in alloys, electronics, and electroplating

ex.en: Photovoltaic cells rely on amorphous or crystalline silicon, cadmium telluride, or copper indium selenide and sulfide.
ex.zh: 光伏电池依赖于非晶态或晶态的硅，碲化镉或者硒化、硫化铜铟。

ex.en: He says not only does arsenic belong under phosphorus, I predict that there is an element that lies below aluminum and above indium.
ex.zh: 他认为不仅砷属于在磷下面，我预言还有一个元素,是在铝之上和铟的下边的。

senses.en: If you say that someone is individualistic, you mean that they like to think and do things in their own way, rather than imitating other people. You can also say that a society is individualistic if it encourages people to behave in this way.

ex.en: Most artists are very individualistic.
ex.zh: 大多数艺术家都非常我行我素。

words.remmethod: individual(个人) + ist(表人/…主义) + ic(…的) → 个人主义的

senses.zh: 个性,(通常用复数)个人的嗜好
senses.en: the qualities that make someone or something different from other things or people

ex.en: We like our staff to show their individuality rather than wear a uniform.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢员工穿出个性，而不是穿制服。

words.remmethod: individual(个人的) + ity(名词后缀) → 个性

senses.en: separately, not together in a group

ex.en: The bridegroom thanked them all individually.
ex.zh: 新郎向他们一一道谢。

ex.en: individually wrapped portions of cheese
ex.zh: 独立包装的一份份干酪

words.remmethod: in(不) + divid(分) + ual(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 个别地

senses.en: a reason for doing something, especially something that you will get as a result

ex.en: financial inducements to attract good job candidates
ex.zh: 吸引优秀人才前来应征的经济诱因

words.remmethod: 来自induce(v. 引诱)

ex.en: In addition, plants have also evolved an adaptive inducible resistance mechanism in response to pathogen invasion.
ex.zh: 同时，植物还形成了一套适应性更广的可诱导的抗病机制。

senses.en: a common river-fish, often used for food, or the flesh of this fish

a mass of diseased cells in your body that have divided and increased too quickly

ex.zh: 我觉得她的态度让人完全不能接受。

very surprising and difficult to explain

ex.zh: 她在路易丝面前总是感到的莫名羞涩

ex.zh: 在和她讲话时，他无意识地用手里的鞭子抽打着一棵树。

words.remmethod: un(不) + dis(否定) + put(思考) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无可置辩的

ex.en: The place is rife with smugglers, dealers, undocumented immigrants, and slaves.
ex.zh: 这里到处都是走私者、交易商、无证移民甚至奴隶。

ex.en: “The plan would bring undocumented workers already in this country out of the shadows without amnesty and without animosity,” he said.
ex.zh: 他说："这项方案将使已在美国的无证件非法移民无需通过大赦、也不引起敌对情绪地摆脱阴影。

words.remmethod: un(不) + document(文件) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无证明的

senses.zh: 过度地；不适当地；不正当地
senses.en: more than is normal or reasonable

senses.zh: 不适当地， 过度地， 不正当地
senses.en: more than is normal or reasonable

ex.en: It didn’t trouble me unduly.
ex.zh: 这事并没有让我太烦恼。

words.remmethod: un (不) + duly (适当， 合适，适度) → 不适当地， 过分地， 过度地

senses.en: not deserved

ex.en: The abolition of incomes unearned by work.
ex.zh: 第十一条，取缔不劳而获的收入。

ex.en: The worst guilt is to accept an unearned guilt.
ex.zh: 最严重的罪行是接受一个不劳而获的罪行。

words.remmethod: un(不) + earn(赚得) + ed(形容词后缀) → 不劳而获的

senses.en: not educated to the usual level, or showing that someone is not well educated

ex.en: a largely uneducated workforce
ex.zh: 大部分人都没受过教育的劳动力

words.remmethod: un(未) + educate(教育) + (e)d(形容词后缀) → 没受教育的；文盲的

senses.zh: 不断的, 不断重复的
senses.en: something, especially something bad, that is unending seems as if it will continue for ever

ex.en: an unending stream of people
ex.zh: 源源不断的人流

words.remmethod: un(不) + end(结束) + ing(形容词后缀) → 不结束的 → 不断的

senses.zh: 不同的， 不相等的； 不平等的， 不相称的； 不胜任的
senses.en: used to describe a situation or a social system which is unfair because some groups or people have more power than others

ex.en: an unequal contest
ex.zh: 不公平的竞赛

ex.en: the unequal distribution of wealth
ex.zh: 不公平的财富分配

words.remmethod: un(不) + equ(相等) + al(形容词) → 不相等的；不平等的

senses.en: completely clear and without any possibility of doubt

senses.zh: 明确的； 坦白的， 直率的
senses.en: completely clear and without any possibility of doubt

ex.en: His answer was an unequivocal ‘No.’
ex.zh: 他的回答是毫不含糊的“不”。

words.remmethod: un (不) + equi (相等) + voc (说) + al → 不说中立的话 → 明确的

senses.en: morally unacceptable

ex.en: unethical medical practices
ex.zh: 不道德的医疗行为

words.remmethod: un(不) + ethical(道德的) → 不道德的
un(未) + expect(预期) + ed(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 意外地
un(不) + fail(失败) + ing(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 不失败地 → 可靠地

ex.en: And that's going to require some very hard choices. And we're going to have to do that in a way that does not add unfairly to the burdens that the average American already faces.
ex.zh: 他还称,"这就需要作出一些十分困难的选择.我们达到此目的所采取的方式,将不会向普通美国人已面临的负担中,增加不公平的累赘."

words.remmethod: un(不) + fair(公平) + ly(副词后缀) → 不公平地

senses.en: not known to you

ex.en: a crowd of unfamiliar faces
ex.zh: 一群陌生的面孔

words.remmethod: un(不)+familiar(熟悉的)→不熟悉的
un(不) + favor(善意；赞成) + ably(可…地) → 不利地

senses.en: not dealing with or paying attention to the most important ideas, causes etc

ex.en: The discussion was becom­ing unfocused.
ex.zh: 讨论的焦点越来越分散。

words.remmethod: un(未) + focus(焦点) + ed(形容词) → 未聚焦的

senses.en: an unforeseen situation is one that you did not expect to happen

ex.en: Radiation may damage cells in a way that was previously unforeseen.
ex.zh: 辐射也许会以以前未预见的方式损坏细胞。

words.remmethod: un(不) + fore(预先) + seen(看见) → 无法预料的

senses.en: not kind or friendly

ex.en: The old man looked cross and unfriendly.
ex.zh: 老人看上去生气了，很不友好。

ex.en: a lonely unfriendly place
ex.zh: 偏僻冷漠的地方

words.remmethod: un(不)+friendly(友好的)→不友好的

senses.zh: 无阻的, 不受阻碍的
senses.en: without hindrance

ex.en: he could proceed unhindered

words.remmethod: un(不) + hinder(阻碍) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无阻的；不受阻碍的

senses.en: created from more than one part, group etc

ex.en: a unified approach
ex.zh: 统一的方法

ex.en: a unified market
ex.zh: 统一的市场

words.remmethod: uni(单一) ＋ fy(使…) → 统一

senses.en: the concept that the earth's surface was shaped in the past by gradual processes, such as erosion, and by small sudden changes, such as earthquakes, of the type acting today rather than by the sudden divine acts, such as the flood survived by Noah (Genesis 6

words.remmethod: uni(单一) + form(形式) + arian(表人/主张者) + ism(主义) → 均变论
un(未) + in(入) + corpor(团体) + ated(形容词后缀) → 未合并的

senses.en: not having enough knowledge or information

ex.en: Parents were left anxious, uninformed, and isolated.
ex.zh: 家长们忧心忡忡，不知道情况到底如何，感到孤立无援。

ex.en: uninformed criticism from uninformed journalists
ex.zh: 来自不了解情况的新闻记者的毫无根据的批评

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 无知的，未受过教育的

senses.en: if a place is uninhabitable, it is impossible to live in

ex.en: Much of the country is uninhabitable because it is desert.
ex.zh: 由于地处沙漠，这个国家的许多地区不适宜居住。

ex.en: Many houses were so badly damaged in the war that they were made permanently uninhabitable.
ex.zh: 很多房屋在战争中严重受损，再也不能居住了。

words.remmethod: un(不) + in(内) + habit(居住) + able(可…的) → 不适宜居住的

senses.en: Unintended results were not planned to happen, although they happened

words.remmethod: un(不) + in(入) + tend(伸展) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未伸向 → 意想不到的

ex.en: I brushed up against him unintentionally.
ex.zh: 我无意中碰了他一下。

ex.en: But then there are the things he taught me unintentionally, like when he arrived home from work for the last time and crawled up the stairs.
ex.zh: 但后来有些事情发生了，那些他无意中教我的事情，就如当他最后一次下班回家爬上楼梯的情景。

words.remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 无意地

senses.en: If you describe something or someone as uninteresting, you mean they have no special or exciting qualities

ex.en: Their media have earned the reputation for being rather dull and uninteresting.
ex.zh: 他们的媒体得到的名声是乏味无聊。

words.remmethod: un(不) + interest(兴趣) + ing(…的) → 无趣味的

senses.en: continuous

ex.en: uninterrupted sleep
ex.zh: 不间断的睡眠

words.remmethod: un(不) + interrupt(打断) + ed(形容词后缀) → 不停的；连续的

ex.en: During the past 40 years, the fraction of unionized civilian workers fell steeply-and not only in the United States- while the unionization of government workers fell only a little.
ex.zh: 在过去40年里，非政府工人在联合会的比例大幅度下降——这种现象不止发生在美国——而政府员工在联合会的比例仅小幅度下降。

words.remmethod: union(联合；工会) + ization(…化) → 工会化；联合
uni(单一) + que(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 独特地；唯一地

senses.en: the state or quality of being universal

ex.en: Secondly, the relationship between universality and specificity.
ex.zh: 第二，普遍性与特殊性的关系。

ex.en: But that should not deter us from seeing its nobility and universality.
ex.zh: 但这不应阻碍我们看到它的高贵和普遍性。

words.remmethod: universal(普遍的) + ity(名词后缀) → 普遍性

senses.en: not realizing what you are doing or what is happening

ex.en: Some governments have been victims and perhaps unknowing accomplices in the bank's activities.
ex.zh: 有些政府曾是银行行为的受害者或不知情的同谋。

words.remmethod: un(不) + know(知道) + ing(表状态) → 不知道的；无知的

senses.zh: 难处理的, 难控制的
senses.en: difficult to control or deal with

ex.en: People were visiting the house every day, sometimes in unmanageable numbers.
ex.zh: 每天都有人来参观这座房子，有时人数多得难以管理。

words.remmethod: un(不) + manage(管理) + able(可…的) → 难处理的

senses.en: easy to recognize

ex.en: the unmistakable sound of gunfire
ex.zh: 清清楚楚的枪炮声

words.remmethod: un(不) + mistake(弄错) + able(可…的) → 不会弄错的

senses.en: different from what you would normally expect

ex.en: It was very cold, which seemed unnatural for late spring.
ex.zh: 天很冷，对于晚春来说似乎不正常。

words.remmethod: un(不) + natur(自然) + al(形容词后缀) → 不自然的；反常的

ex.en: What you should not do is prevent or override it unnecessarily.
ex.zh: 您不应该做的是不必要地阻止或重写它。

ex.en: An awful lot of people with depression suffer unnecessarily because of a fear of using medication, but it can be very effective.
ex.zh: 一个可怕的抑郁症的人很多遭受不必要的，因为使用药物的恐惧，但它可以是非常有效的。

words.remmethod: un(不) + necessary(必要的) + ly(副词后缀) → 不必要地

senses.en: not easily seen or detected; imperceptible

ex.en: They might kill people slowly in a way that's unnoticeable, taking effect over perhaps 10 - 30 years by accelerating degenerative diseases.
ex.zh: 它们可能用不引人注意的方式缓慢地杀害人民，促进退化性疾病也许在10-30年生效。

words.remmethod: un(否定) + notice(注意) + able(可…的) → 不引人注意的

ex.en: It basically means that you have a theory about the unobservable psychological states that are governing — or causing — other people's behaviors.
ex.zh: 这基本上意味着你能推测到，那些支配或引起他人行为的不可观察的心理状态。

words.remmethod: un(不) + ob(朝) + serv(看) + able(可…的) → 不可见的

senses.en: impossible to get

ex.en: Fresh fruit was unobtainable in the winter.
ex.zh: 新鲜水果在冬季是买不到的。

words.remmethod: un(不) + obtain(获得) + able(可…的) → 无法得到的

senses.en: a seat, house, room etc that is unoccupied has no one in it

ex.en: However, to do so, it must find an unoccupied territory and a member of the opposite sex with which to mate.
ex.zh: 然而，要想成为领头狼，必须找到一块未被占领的领地和一头能够与之交配的异性狼。

words.remmethod: un(未) + occupy(占据) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未被占据的 → 空闲的

senses.en: not planned or expected

ex.en: an unplanned pregnancy
ex.zh: 意外怀孕

words.remmethod: un(不) + planned(计划过的) → 意外的

senses.zh: 不流行的, 不受欢迎的
senses.en: not liked by most people

ex.en: an unpopular choice
ex.zh: 不得人心的选择

ex.en: an unpopular teacher
ex.zh: 不受欢迎的老师

words.remmethod: un(不) + popul(人民) + ar(形容词后缀) → 不受欢迎的；不流行的

ex.en: The danger lies in its unpredictability. Yet that may also be a reason for hope.
ex.zh: 危险就在于其不可预测性，而这也可能是希望尚存的一个原因吧。

ex.en: With the unpredictability of the volcano, authorities widened the danger zone around the mountain to 20 kilometers.
ex.zh: 鉴于这一火山的不可预测性，印尼官员将“危险区域”扩大到方圆20公里。

words.remmethod: un(不) + pre(预先) + dict(说) + ability(能力；性质) → 不可预测性

senses.zh: 不可预见地,  不能预料地

ex.en: Because the cave fish may not need less sleep—they may need to stay awake to forage more in an environment where food can be scarce and appear unpredictably.
ex.zh: 因为穴居鱼可能并不需要睡得更少——它们可能需要保持清醒，以便更经常地在食物短缺和食物不常出现的环境中觅食。

words.remmethod: un(不) + predict(预言) + ably(可…地) → 不可预见地

senses.en: (of food, oil, etc) not having undergone a process to preserve or purify

ex.en: Reduce packaging by eating more whole, unprocessed foods and using the bulk bins for items that have a long shelf-life.
ex.zh: 减少包装，通过吃全食品、未经加工的食品以及对物品使用有很长的保质期的散装箱。

ex.en: Even a vegan who eats lots of canned and boxed foods is on a very different diet than one who eats only fresh, unprocessed foods.
ex.zh: 一种食用大量罐头和盒装食物的严格素食饮食，跟只吃新鲜的、未经加工的食物的严格素食饮食是完全不同的。

words.remmethod: un(未) + process(加工) + ed(表状态) → 未被加工的

senses.zh: 没有利润的, 无益的
senses.en: making no profit

ex.en: unprofitable businesses
ex.zh: 不赢利的企业

words.remmethod: un(无) + profit(利润) + able(能…的) → 没有利润的；无益的

senses.zh: 无保护的, 未做防护措施的
senses.en: not protected against possible harm or damage

ex.en: Thieves often target unprotected vehicles.
ex.zh: 窃贼常常瞄准未采取防护措施的车辆。

ex.en: Part-time workers are unprotected by this law.
ex.zh: 兼职职员不受这条法规保护。

words.remmethod: un(无) + protect(保护) + ed(…的) → 无保护的

senses.zh: 未经证明的, 未经检验的
senses.en: not proved or tested

ex.en: unproven allegations
ex.zh: 未经证实的指控

ex.en: unproven medical treatments
ex.zh: 未经试验的治疗方法

words.remmethod: un(未) + prov(试验；证明) + en(过去分词) → 未经证明的

senses.zh: 未公开出版的,未发表过的
senses.en: unpublished writing, information etc has never been published

words.remmethod: un(未) + publish(出版) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未出版的

senses.zh: 不能到达的,  不能得到的

ex.en: Objects that are unmarked at the end of the mark phase are unreachable by the application (dead) because there's no path from the root set through any series of references to find them.
ex.zh: 标记阶段最后也没有标记的对象是应用程序不可获得的对象（死对象），因为不存在从根集经过任何引用序列找到这些对象的路径。

ex.en: Russell said he couldn't get answers about his own treatment, and the man who once spent so much time offering care and advice was unreachable.
ex.zh: 拉塞尔说他不能从自己的治疗中得出答案，并且这个曾经花费许多时间提供关心和建议的人是遥不可及的。

words.remmethod: un(不) + reach(到达) + able(可…的) → 不能到达的；不能得到的

senses.zh: 没有人看的, 无学问的

words.remmethod: un(未) + read(读) → 没有人看的；无学问的

senses.en: an experience, situation etc that is unreal seems so strange that you think you must be imagining it

ex.en: It seemed unreal to be sitting and talking to someone so famous.
ex.zh: 和这么一位大名鼎鼎的人坐在一起谈话似乎很不真实。

words.remmethod: un(不) + real(真实) → 不真实的

senses.en: unrealistic ideas or hopes are not reasonable or sensible

ex.en: Some parents have totally unrealistic expectations of teachers.
ex.zh: 有些家长对老师抱着完全不切实际的期望。

words.remmethod: un(非) + real(真实的) + istic(…的) → 不真实的 → 不切实际的

senses.zh: 未被承认的, 无法识别的
senses.en: someone or something that is unrecognizable has changed or been damaged so much that you do not recognize them

ex.en: I hadn’t been to the city for 20 years and it was almost unrecognizable.
ex.zh: 我已经 20 年没有到过这座城市，几乎认不出来了。

words.remmethod: un(不) + recognize(认出) + able(可…的) → 无法识别的；未被承认的

senses.en: an unresolved problem or question has not been answered or solved

ex.en: the unresolved issue of who will pay for the project
ex.zh: 项目由谁出资这个悬而未决的问题

ex.en: an unresolved conflict
ex.zh: 没有解决的冲突

words.remmethod: un(未) + re(再) + solv(解) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未解决的

senses.zh: 天生的,未受学校教育的
senses.en: An unschooled person has had no formal education

words.remmethod: un(未) + school(学校教育) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未受学校教育的；天生的

senses.en: not noticed or seen

ex.en: Raj crept out of the house unseen.
ex.zh: 拉杰悄悄地溜出了房子。

ex.en: unseen dangers
ex.zh: 潜在的危险

words.remmethod: un(不) + seen(被看见的) → 未见过的

ex.en: A term given to viewers who are unselective about the content they watch.
ex.zh: 指那些对所收看的节目内容不加选择的观众。

words.remmethod: un(非) + select(选择) + ive(形容词后缀) → 非选择性的

ex.en: companies employing unskilled labour
ex.zh: 雇用非熟练工的公司

words.remmethod: un(不) + skill(技能) + ed(形容词) → 不熟练的

senses.en: not known or not stated

ex.en: The meeting will take place at an unspecified date in the future.
ex.zh: 会议将于日后召开，具体日期不确定。

words.remmethod: un(未) + specif(指定) + ied(形容词后缀) → 未指定的 → 未详细说明的

senses.en: not praised or famous for something you have done, although you deserve to be

ex.en: one of the unsung heroes of French politics
ex.zh: 法国政坛的一位无名英雄

words.remmethod: un(未；不) + sung(唱) → 未被歌唱的 → 未赞颂的

senses.zh: 没有自信的, 不确定的
senses.en: not certain about something or about what you have to do

ex.en: Chris seemed nervous and unsure of herself.
ex.zh: 克丽丝显得紧张，没有自信。

words.remmethod: un(不) + sure(确定的) → 不确定的

ex.en: The public psychosocial status is mostly affected by the unsureness of information in the event of epidemic outbreak.
ex.zh: 面对疫情及突发事件，信息的不确定性是影响民众心态变化的主要因素。

words.remmethod: un(不) + sure(确定) + ness(名词后缀) → 不确定；缺乏自信

senses.zh: 未知的, 未被怀疑的
senses.en: If you describe something as unsuspected, you mean that people do not realize it or are not aware of it

ex.en: A surprising number of ailments are caused by unsuspected environmental factors.
ex.zh: 惊人数量的慢性病是由未知的环境因素引起的。

words.remmethod: un(未) + suspect(怀疑) + ed(…的) → 未被怀疑的；未知的

senses.en: working very hard for a long period of time in order to do something – used to show approval

ex.en: untiring efforts to help the homeless
ex.zh: 帮助无家可归者的不懈努力

words.remmethod: un(不) + tir(e)(疲倦) + ing(形容词后缀) → 不知疲倦的

senses.zh: 非传统的,不符合传统的

ex.en: He moved to New York and performed an untraditional roster of penniless actor jobs – yoga instructor, manure shoveller, railroad-loader.
ex.zh: 他搬到纽约，成为一名一贫如洗的演员，他的工作表上有许多非传统工作——教瑜伽、铲肥料、铺铁路。

ex.en: So what did Ellen's family think of this untraditional celebration? This is her aunt.
ex.zh: 那么什么艾伦的家人认为这非传统的庆祝活动？这是她的姑姑。

words.remmethod: un(非) + tradition(传统) + al(…的) → 非传统的；不符合传统的

senses.en: harmful substances that are untreated have not been made safe

senses.zh: 未经处理的, 未经治疗的
senses.en: an untreated illness or injury has not had medical treatment

ex.en: untreated sewage
ex.zh: 未经处理过的污水

words.remmethod: un(未) + treat(处理) + ed(表被动/状态) → 未经处理的

senses.en: someone who is untrustworthy cannot be trusted

ex.en: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
ex.zh: 我觉得他肤浅、虚荣，并不值得信赖。

words.remmethod: 组合词: un(不) + trust(信任) + worthy(值得的) → 不值得信任的

senses.zh: 拆开(搓合的绳,线等), 解开

ex.en: Allow any part of the subtle bodies that is twisted to untwist and separate from any other that one is intertwined with.
ex.zh: 允许精细身体中扭曲的任何部分解开扭曲，从混杂在一起的其它部分中分离开来。

words.remmethod: un(去除) + twist(搓合) → 拆开；解开

senses.en: something that is unusable is in such a bad condition that you cannot use it

ex.en: Bombing had made roads and railways unusable.
ex.zh: 轰炸使得公路和铁路都不能用。

words.remmethod: un(不) + us(用) + able(能…的) → 不能用的

senses.en: not being used, or never used
not being used, or never used
